description: Renderer permissions for the main window. Without a capability every core-plugin command is denied by the ACL, which silently killed the app's whole event channel: the renderer's `listen()` calls (evt:status / evt:log / evt:playlist / evt:settings, and the webview drag-drop events) all go through `plugin:event|listen`, and `core:webview` carries the drag-drop listener. Application commands are not ACL-gated, which is why the app seemed to work while nothing live ever reached the UI.
